posts.author: Rohith_Raj
posts.text: Never take NDTV Profit seriously again — Another reminder to never trust anything based on media hype. These TRP’s and clicks drive the narrative, not necessarily accuracy. Once you gain enough market experience, you realise that independent research is far more reliable than these headlines.

posts.author: BB789
posts.text: Never take NDTV Profit seriously again — I’m surprised an indian news media actually apologized. But why? Were they forced to do so by SEBI or other forces? Don’t news channels do this regularly though? STT hike or something else was presented by cnbc and they never apologized AFAIK.
